complete_examples.text: Article An advanced vehicle–slab track interaction model considering rail random irregularities Lei Xu1, Zhaowei Chen2 and Wanming Zhai1 Abstract This paper investigates a more advanced vertical vehicle–slab track interaction model (VTIM) by considering the discontinuity of track slabs, besides, it can be degenerated to the traditional two-dimensional model conveniently.

Excited by rail random irregularities, severe dynamic interactions between railway rolling stocks and guiding tracks have attracted much concern in the field of design and maintenance of track structures as well as the assessment of safety and comfort of railway transportation, especially for trains running at speeds of higher than 300 km/h (Ferreira and Lo ́ pez-Pita, 2015; Nguyen et al., 2014; Paixa ̃ o et al., 2001; Steenbergen et al., 2007; Vale and Calc ̧ ada, 2014; Zhai and Sun, 1994; Zhai et al., 2015).
